software.title: SDA Vision: Synthetic-media Discourse Analysis
software.description: Research software and a separate prepared-example demonstration for examining AI-generated and traditional media. The recorded demo offers side-by-side SynthID Detector and OpenAI paste-results boxes. Session notes remain separate from recorded model assessments and content-credential findings.

guide_resources.title: SDA Vision: Facilitator field guide and participant checks
guide_resources.description: Eight-page illustrated facilitator guide and one-page participant sheet for Notice, Discuss, Check and Reflect, with a simplified prepared-example SynthID Detector and OpenAI workflow. Editable Markdown and HTML/CSS accompany the PDFs.
